arguments.need: I really miss the little terminal pet that used to sit in my AI coding assistant, and I'd like something that brings a companion like that back so it remembers me between sessions and levels up as I work. I bounce between a few command-line AI coding tools, so it needs to plug into any of them through MCP rather than only one. It also has to keep everything on my own machine with nothing sent over the network, and ideally it can import my old pet's name and stats from the old config file.
